name: Yatou Sayo
source:
Official Position: None
Estate: None

Second eldest girl in the Yatou household.

Her personality is less ditzy and she is more reliable than her sister Emoshichi.

Sometimes she tries to seduce Suguha but it is hard to tell if she is serious or just teasing.

She quietly brags about how her chest has recently grown larger than Emoshischi's
